verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?

verdicts.photo_observation: Color-coded routing (red=DC cable, purple=AC cable, green=earthing, per the page 4 legend) is traced consistently: rooftop 'Cable Routing' photo (page 11) shows red/green/purple lines at the roof corner; page 12 top shows the same colors connecting DCDB-Inverter-ACDB boxes against a wall, and the photo below it shows two real conduit pipes running down the building exterior at that same location; pages 13-14 continue the routing down narrow building gaps with a green/purple line to the 'Equipment Location' photo (page 14) where the lines terminate at the DCDB/Inverter/ACDB boxes; page 15 shows a purple line connecting Main meter to Solar meter inside the switchboard.
verdicts.rationale: The routing color-coding is consistent across all photos from roof to main panel, exposed sections show real conduit pipes matching the marked path, and no orphan/disconnected segments or unexplained size changes are apparent, though the run cannot be tracked through 100% of its physical length across gaps between consecutive photos.
